body.purpose: All running copy, labels, and controls.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing curve used anywhere in the UI, per CLAUDE.md Animation timing.

motion.name: duration-default-max
motion.purpose: Ceiling for all UI animation: hover, press, toggles, modals, menus, lists, navigation.

motion.name: duration-focal-entrance
motion.purpose: Exception for a rare focal entrance on a marketing surface only (e.g. listing-page hero). Never on repeated interactions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The site's one CTA treatment: signal red fill, used once per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-signal-red); color: #ffffff; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 600; border: none; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #a80e17; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The repeated form-field pattern used across every scanned admin and public form.
components.css: .ds-input { border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-ink); background: var(--color-bg-base); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink); outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: A functional car-dealership inventory site: ink-black type on a white base, with signal red reserved for exactly one call-to-action or accent per screen. The codebase enforces this itself in comments rejecting red fills at several call sites, and status badges deliberately never use red.
keyCharacteristics: Two typefaces, one role each: Archivo for display/wordmark, Barlow for everything else.
One accent color (signal red), applied narrowly by convention.
Flat surfaces, hairline borders, rounded-lg as the default corner radius.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Signal red is the only accent color and appears on at most one primary action or emphasis per screen. Status indicators never use it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A shadow appears only on a floating/overlay element, never as general card or button styling.

dos: Do reserve signal red (#d0121b) for one primary action or emphasis per screen.
Do use border-hairline for separation instead of shadows.
Do use rounded-lg as the default corner radius for buttons, inputs, and cards.

Do keep all UI animation at or under 300ms using cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); reserve 500-800ms only for a rare focal entrance on a marketing surface, never on hover, press, toggles, modals, menus, lists, or navigation.
donts: Don't use signal red for status indicators (Reserved/Sold) -- both use ink or muted text instead.
Don't introduce a third typeface; Archivo and Barlow cover every documented use.
Don't add shadows to cards or buttons as a default treatment; shadows are reserved for floating/overlay elements only.
